flagged.title: Plate Tectonics & Hazard Distribution
flagged.reason: F8 is mark-affecting because the video states and displays on screen that the 2011 Christchurch earthquake was magnitude 6.9 rather than 6.3, falsely teaching students that the magnitude was practically identical to Haiti's 7.0.

mark_affecting.quote: Christchurch New Zealand faced a practically identical 6.9 magnitude quake.
